scripts.ui:build: bash scripts/build-css.sh && pnpm exec bun scripts/copy-mermaid.ts && pnpm exec bun build src/ui/index.tsx --target browser --outdir out/ui --sourcemap=external --minify --entry-naming bundle.[ext] --asset-naming bundle.[ext] && cp src/ui/index.html out/ui/index.html
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm exec bun build integrations/desktop/main.ts integrations/desktop/preload.ts --target node --format cjs --external electron --entry-naming "[name].cjs" --outdir out/desktop
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm exec bun test test/unit/ test/integration/ && pnpm run test:ui
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build && pnpm exec bun test test/integration/
scripts.test:bb: npm --prefix integrations/bb test && npm --prefix integrations/bb run typecheck
scripts.version: npm --prefix integrations/desktop version "$npm_new_version" --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version && git add integrations/desktop/package.json integrations/desktop/package-lock.json
scripts.style: node node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome check --error-on-warnings --write . && pnpm exec tsc
scripts.style:check: node node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome check --error-on-warnings . && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm exec bun scripts/check-docs.ts
